blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Small talk looks easy, but it is very useful. A short, friendly chat can open doors at work. Today we practise "like + -ing", the simplest way to talk about hobbies and weekends.

You can say: "I like working in London." Sophie likes walking by the Thames. James loves watching football on the weekend. We use "like + -ing" to talk about things we enjoy in general.

The weather is the easiest way to start. Weekends are a good topic on Monday. Keep your answers short, and then ask back: "And you?" At work, do not talk about politics or religion.

items.q: What is the text about?
items.why: O texto ensina small talk usando "like + -ing".

items.q: What does James love doing on the weekend?
items.why: "James loves watching football on the weekend."

items.q: According to the text, what is the easiest way to start small talk?
items.why: "The weather is the easiest way to start."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Small talk can help at work.
The weather is an easy topic.
You should talk about religion at work.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz para NÃO falar de política ou religião no trabalho.

items.q: Asking "And you?" suggests that…
options: you want the other person to talk too
you do not like the person
you want to end the chat
items.why: Inferência: perguntar de volta mantém a conversa e mostra interesse.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com um colega no corredor. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Good morning. How was your weekend?

Mine was really nice, thank you. I like walking by the Thames on Saturday. The weather was good, so I walked for two hours. I love music too, so on Sunday I went to a small concert with a friend. It was great.

And you? Do you have a hobby? Oh, football? Nice! My colleague James loves watching football on the weekend. He talks about it every Monday.

I don't play sports, but I like cooking at home. It's my little hobby. Cooking helps me relax after work.

Well, it's nine o'clock. We have a meeting soon. Let's get a coffee first. It was nice to talk to you. See you later!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie like doing on Saturday?
items.why: "I like walking by the Thames on Saturday."

items.q: What did Sophie do on Sunday?
items.why: "On Sunday I went to a small concert with a friend."

items.q: What is Sophie's little hobby?
items.why: "I like cooking at home. It's my little hobby."

items.q: The talk suggests that Sophie is…
options: in a big hurry to leave
items.why: Inferência: ela puxa conversa, pergunta de volta e convida para um café.

items.q: Why does Sophie say "Let's get a coffee first"?
options: There is time before the meeting
She does not like the meeting room
She wants to skip the meeting
items.why: Inferência: são nove horas e a reunião é logo, então dá tempo de um café antes.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I like working in London." Like here means…
items.why: Like = gostar de / enjoy (curtir).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "See you on Monday! Have a nice ___."
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana; é o que vem depois de sexta.

items.q: "Cooking is my little hobby." A hobby is…
items.why: Hobby = algo que você faz por prazer no tempo livre.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "James loves watching ___ on TV every weekend."
items.why: Football = futebol; é o que se assiste na TV.

items.q: "I love music, so I went to a concert." Music is…
options: songs and sounds you listen to
items.why: Music = música; sons e canções que ouvimos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em small talk no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's catch up over coffee." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, trocar novidades.

items.q: "How is it going?" This is a friendly way to ask…
items.why: "How is it going?" = Como vai?, um cumprimento informal.

items.q: "Let's grab a coffee before the meeting." To grab a coffee means to…
items.why: Grab a coffee = pegar um café rápido, de forma casual.

items.q: "Nice to talk to you. See you later!" This means…
items.why: See you later = até mais, uma despedida amigável.

items.q: "I went to a concert on Sunday." "Oh, what about you?" This asks…
items.why: What about you? = E você? — devolve a pergunta e mantém a conversa.
